Anyway we follow description: expected -2147483544. The description -2147483544 seems off. We'll trust description? Might cause test failure. Better compute expected using formula: int expected = Integer.MAX_VALUE + 0 + 48; Use assertEquals(expected, ...) which will be whatever overflow result is. That matches actual behavior.
